name: Sushi Bar Cooked Shrimp Nigiri (Ebi Nigiri)
whyItWorks: Butterflied sweet shrimp gently poached in water and placed over sushi rice. Tender, ultra-lean, low-fat, and safe for patients who prefer fully cooked seafood options over raw fish.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Ebi Nigiri (cooked shrimp)—Sabi-nuki (NO wasabi under the fish).' Dip in tamari.
